title: Post-deploy chunk-load rejection surfaces as a generic error screen rather than a reload prompt
evidence: Suspense at App.jsx:154 handles pending lazy imports but not rejected ones. AppErrorBoundary (main.jsx:43-45) catches the throw, so there is no white screen, but it renders a generic error rather than prompting the reload that actually fixes a rotated chunk manifest.
impact: A user with an open tab during a deploy sees an unexplained error screen. Cache-Control no-store on HTML plus immutable on /assets/* means a manual reload does recover, so impact is confusion rather than a stuck app.

title: PWA manifest ships a single SVG icon with no apple-touch-icon, no raster PNG and no maskable purpose, and a contract test locks it in
evidence: manifest icons array contains exactly one entry, /brand/peekalisting-binoculars.svg, sizes 'any', purpose 'any'. index.html declares rel=icon and rel=mask-icon but no rel=apple-touch-icon. The test asserts manifest.icons.every(icon => icon.src === '/brand/peekalisting-binoculars.svg').
impact: iOS ignores the manifest for home-screen icons and needs a PNG apple-touch-icon, so Add to Home Screen yields a blank or screenshot icon on iPhone and iPad. Android adaptive masking crops or letterboxes the mark and the splash screen has no raster source. The product is mobile-first and actively prompts installation, so this hits the primary install path. The contract test would fail any correct fix.
reproduction: Add to Home Screen on iOS Safari; inspect the installed icon
root_cause: Icon set reduced to a single SVG during the rebrand and then frozen by a test assertion
recommended_fix: Add 180px apple-touch-icon plus 192/512 PNG icons and a maskable variant, all PeekaListing-branded; relax the test to assert brand correctness rather than an exact single-source icon list
test_to_prove_fix: Manifest test asserting presence of 192/512 raster icons and a maskable purpose, plus an apple-touch-icon link in index.html
notes: public/brand/findit-icon-180.png is the right size but off-brand and unreferenced

title: listings.attributes and services.attributes are never written and hold the default document permanently
evidence: 0114 adds attributes jsonb not null default '{"version":1,"values":{}}' with CHECK is_valid_attribute_document. create_v1_listing_submission omits attributes from its INSERT column list entirely. listingCreationRepository sends only p_submission_key, p_listing, p_detail and p_media.
impact: The CHECK constraint validates a document that is always empty, giving the appearance of a validated flexible attribute system that stores nothing. Any future consumer reading attributes will silently get empty values for every listing.
reproduction: Inspect the INSERT column list in create_v1_listing_submission; attributes is absent

recommended_fix: Persist the attribute document in the submission RPC with server-side field validation, or drop the columns and constraint

title: Stored attributes are 4-7 columns per vertical; duty/import status, utilities, tenure, capacity and land-vs-built size are absent from the database
evidence: property_details stores only property_type, bedrooms, bathrooms, size_sqm. car_details stores brand, model, year, mileage, fuel_type, transmission, condition. machinery_details stores machinery_type, brand, model, condition, year, usage_hours.
impact: Buyers cannot filter or compare on attributes the brief identifies as decision-critical in this market: vehicle duty/import status, property tenure and title, borehole/solar/ZESA/water/sewer utilities, land versus built size with units, machinery capacity/payload and certification. For fraud-sensitive verticals these are exactly the fields that separate a credible listing from a bait listing.
reproduction: Inspect the three detail tables; compare against the attribute matrix
root_cause: Detail tables modelled minimally at v1; the richer registry that would have covered them was never wired (F-019)
recommended_fix: Add the market-critical fields as typed columns with constraints and indexes, prioritising vehicle duty/import status and property tenure/utilities
test_to_prove_fix: pgTAP asserting each required attribute column exists with its constraint, plus a search filter test
notes: Machinery correctly uses engine hours rather than mileage — recorded as a strength

title: p_detail values are cast but not range-validated in the submission RPC and unknown enum values silently coerce to 'other'
evidence: Detail inserts use nullif(p_detail->>'bedrooms','')::integer with no upper bound, and coalesce(nullif(p_detail->>'propertyType',''),'other')::public.property_type so an unrecognised type becomes 'other' rather than raising.
impact: Absurd but type-valid values (bedrooms 9999, size_sqm 0.01) are accepted and pollute search facets. Silent coercion to 'other' hides client bugs and misclassifies listings rather than rejecting them.
reproduction: Call create_v1_listing_submission with p_detail bedrooms 9999 — accepted
root_cause: Envelope validation applied to the listing payload but not to the per-category detail payload
recommended_fix: Add range CHECK constraints on detail columns and raise on unknown enum values instead of coercing
test_to_prove_fix: pgTAP asserting out-of-range bedrooms and an unknown property_type are both rejected
notes: Existing constraints already cover negative values and implausible years
